Question
========
Which analytical lens does this module use to explain rising inequality?

Answerlist
----------
* The capability approach combined with a systemic and structural approach
* A purely individual approach based on effort
* A libertarian approach based on voluntary exchange
* A utilitarian approach based on total welfare

Solution
========
The module combines the capability approach with a structural view of institutions, rules, and power (Bader and Bieri 2023).
